Sam: heads up — since the runtime tweak yesterday we're seeing 95th pct decode latency go up ~18% for short-chat workloads. looks like small-generation paths are getting merged into larger prefill batches and the KV cache misses spike.
Jin: saw this in the perf run too. attached flamegraph shows extra kernel binds during handshake -> gen transition. seems kernel selection flips from fused-attn to slower fallback when mixed-phase batches hit the queue.
Nicole: ugh, mixing phases again. can we force phase-aware batching? i.e., keep prefill vs decode separate queues for the first N tokens, allow join only after KV warmup threshold.
Sam: here's a quick repro from canary logs (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-18T09:12:34Z] req=abcd phase=prefill tokens=128 kernel=fused_attn on_gpu=0
[2026-03-18T09:12:34Z] req=abcd handshake -> decode tokens_left=32 kv_hit=false kernel=attn_fallback switch
[2026-03-18T09:12:34Z] batch_id=42 merged: prefill+decode size=12 kernel_switches=3
```
Jin: perf traces show KV cache miss rate jumps from 6% -> 34% when batches mix. also observed 40–60ms extra scheduling jitter per request. attaching short perf-bot summary: avg_kv_lookup_us=120 -> 320, kernel_bind_count +1.
perf-bot: nightly-bench/short-chat: baseline(174) -> post-tweak(190) 95th-msec delta +18% ; top correlates: mixed-phase-batches=+27%
Nicole: proposal: implement a soft divider in the batcher. rules: 1) tag requests with phase=(init|gen) 2) separate formation windows for init vs gen for first TOKEN_WINDOW tokens 3) allow cross-join only if queue_age>JOIN_MIN_MS or batch_tokens<SMALL_BATCH_TOKEN_TARGET.
Sam: concrete numbers i tested locally: TOKEN_WINDOW=64, JOIN_MIN_MS=20ms, SMALL_BATCH_TOKEN_TARGET=8; prefill_target_tokens=96, decode_target_tokens=24. this reduced kernel switches and KV coldpath by ~60% in local sim.
Jin: sounds reasonable. also kernel selection heuristic needs tie-breaker: prefer kernel that matches majority phase in batch; if equal, prefer kernel with lower estimated KV-miss penalty.
Nicole: add a KV-warmup heartbeat: after prefill finishes, touch KV for hot keys before decode join. small extra ops but avoids full miss. maybe only for requests > MIN_TOKENS_PRE.
Sam: here's a scheduler delta i sketched in config form:
```
batcher:
  phase_aware: true
  token_window: 64
  join_min_ms: 20
  prefill_target_tokens: 96
  decode_target_tokens: 24
  small_batch_threshold: 8
  kv_warmup_enabled: true
  kv_warmup_limit_tokens: 4
  kernel_tiebreak: prefer_phase_majority
```
Jin: can we add metrics: batch.phase_mix_ratio, kernel.switch_rate, kv.miss_by_phase ? need to see before/after. also add trace id correlation for flamegraphs.
Nicole: agreed. also add an experiment flag so this only runs for canary pool. I'll own rollout.
perf-bot: canary-run queued: feature=phase-aware-batcher, pool=canary-small, replicas=6
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled at 2026-03-18T14:00Z to pool canary-small (id: canary-77) :rocket:
Sam: quick sanity check: what about edge cases where prefill short-circuits to decode immediately (e.g., instruction-following prompts)? our TOKEN_WINDOW must be adaptive.
Jin: good point. we can adapt TOKEN_WINDOW by request length hint or metadata: if user_provided_max_tokens < TOKEN_WINDOW then skip separation. also allow model-config override per-model.
Nicole: i'll add adaptive rule: TOKEN_WINDOW = min(global_token_window, hint_max_tokens, 0.5 * prefill_expected). will push config to canary tonight.
Sam: ok let's instrument and run canary. if 95th improves and kernel.switch_rate drops -> promote. I'll follow up with flamegraphs and kv miss metrics. thanks :thumbsup:
perf-bot: canary-run/phase-aware-batcher results (summary): 95th latency -5% vs current canary; kernel.switch_rate -48%; kv_miss_rate_on_decode -62% ; rollout-recommendation=promote-if-stable
Nicole: sweet. i'll schedule gradual rollout and a quick rollback playbook. Sam/Jin follow up with traces in #eng-runtime after 2h.
Sam: noted — i'll post traces and a short perf note. owner=@Nicole.
Nicole: taking it. will also update docs for scheduler heuristics. :cowboy_hat_face:
